family.shared_definition: a person or organization that purchases goods or receives professional services
family.semantic_notes: 'Client' typically denotes an ongoing professional service relationship, whereas 'customer' usually denotes a transactional retail buyer.

source_context_dev: Consultation meetings were scheduled every second Tuesday without exception. When the lobby elevator opened on schedule, the staff recognized the familiar schedule immediately.
The firm handled recurring advisory retainers on a predictable weekly cadence. As the usual appointment hour arrived, the front desk prepared the standard intake portfolio.

Every month brought another structured review session for the ongoing business engagement. The front office had already printed the routine portfolio review before the visitor stepped through the entryway.
Contractually mandated status updates occurred on a strict, continuous schedule throughout the fiscal year. Right at the scheduled morning hour, the door opened for the periodic check-in.
target_context_dev: Recent post-transaction surveys showed perfect ratings and glowing reviews across the board. The visitor arrived with a wide smile after concluding a seamless purchasing journey.
Following the flawless delivery of merchandise, the buyer expressed immense gratitude over email. Walking into the main showroom, the visitor radiated delight with the entire purchasing experience.

The feedback forms were filled with praise regarding the speedy resolution and stellar service quality. When the visitor returned to express personal appreciation, the atmosphere in the lounge was exceptionally positive.
Having experienced exceptional hospitality during the previous order cycle, the visitor returned in high spirits. The warm reception area was filled with pleasant greetings.
source_context_test: The scheduled advisory sessions had become an established part of the corporate routine over several fiscal quarters. As the designated morning slot arrived, the staff prepared the recurrent briefing binder.
Weekly project reviews followed a standardized protocol without any deviation. The front desk team noted the prompt arrival for the standing appointment.

The ongoing retainer required structured monthly check-ins that were always held on the first business morning. When the bell rang precisely on time, the staff knew the familiar appointment was starting.
Consistent recurring consultations had taken place every month for over three years. As the habitual appointment time struck, footsteps echoed down the main hallway.
target_context_test: The transaction had concluded with outstanding scores on every feedback metric provided by the audit. When the shopper returned to pick up the final documentation, the mood was celebratory.
Every expectation regarding product quality and support responsiveness had been completely surpassed. The purchaser arrived with enthusiastic remarks about the smooth process.
Positive review submissions poured in following the successful fulfillment of the holiday orders. The delighted buyer entered the reception suite eager to continue the pleasant relationship.
The buyer felt completely fulfilled with the outcome of the recent purchase agreement and sent a letter of praise. Entering the building for a follow-up visit, the visitor carried an upbeat demeanor.
constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations (regular/satisfied × client/customer) remain semantically and syntactically well-formed across both professional consultation and transactional purchasing settings.

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations (unhappy/loyal × client/customer) are grammatically valid and semantically meaningful across both grievance-oriented and loyalty-oriented framing.
